legs: Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera keeps gliding slowly forward along the gravel garden path as the light fades into dusk, lamps and string lights coming on, neighbors of all ages strolling ahead toward a softly lit pavilion.

Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera follows the path forward into the glowing pavilion under brick vaults and arrives at the long candlelit table where neighbors of all ages share dinner beside the fire circle.

Single continuous cinematic crane and drone move, no cuts. The camera rises smoothly up and away from the long table, higher and higher above the village at night, revealing the twelve homes glowing around the garden under a sky full of stars and the dark lake beyond.
